fiona (Sales Ops): Heads-up: Concord AI flagged invoice INV-2026-1110 — dispute for an irregular evaluation burst billed as overage. Request: 30% concession on the overage line + one-time payment deferral to Net45. Joel looped in.
joel (Account Exec): Quick facts: affected window Oct 8-10 due to partner onboarding test. Overage = 320k tokens -> $96,000. Customer asking 30% -> $28,800 and Net45. They're leaning toward contract renewal if we resolve fast.
mira (RevOps): Uploading usage audit and partner ingest logs to billing ticket BILL-5114. Preliminary: ~70% of disputed traffic originated from partner sandbox not tagged correctly. We can pursue partner recovery but it may be slow.
paul (Finance): Policy: credits > $25k need Sr Finance approval. Payment terms beyond Net30 require credit manager review. If we keep concession <= $25k we can avoid a longer approval chain. Also need journal entry recommendation and tax check.
fiona (Sales Ops): Proposal: offer 25% one-time concession = $24,000 (keeps under Sr Finance threshold) + Net45 conditional on signed amendment that 1) acknowledges partner sandbox responsibility, 2) adds a 6-month minimum committed spend. That protects revenue and keeps signoff simple.
joel (Account Exec): Customer said they can accept 25% + Net45 if we also promise a quick fix on partner tagging and an acknowledgement they won't be held for future sandbox runs. I can get amendment signed today.
mira (RevOps): Action items: 1) Finalize concession amt 2) Legal amendment template 3) Create NetSuite CM draft (status: pending amendment) 4) Finance sign-off + posting after signed doc. Creating BILL-5114 now.
esther (Legal): I will draft a short amendment and partner acknowledgement. Suggest clause: "one-time remediation credit; not precedent; conditioned on 6-month commit." Need final numbers to insert.
paul (Finance): I can provisionally approve $24k and Net45 if amendment and NetSuite CM draft are attached to BILL-5114 before posting. If final > $25k escalate to Sr Finance. Please include recommended journal entry: Debit Revenue-Adj $24,000; Credit AR $24,000 and note tax reversal if applicable.
deals-bot: Automated: Deal desk route triggered for thread 1977501110. Outstanding approvals: Legal amendment signoff, Finance final confirmation. Link: https://internal.redwood/desk/1977501110
fiona (Sales Ops): Great. Closing criteria: signed amendment uploaded + NetSuite credit memo posted. Joel will drop the signed amendment here when back from call.
joel (Account Exec): On the call now — customer agreed. Uploading signed amendment in 30 min.
paul (Finance): :white_check_mark: Once amendment attached, Finance will post CM in current close. Thanks team.
fiona (Sales Ops): Thanks everyone 97 tagging for audit trail.
